title: Decision
description: A player decision recorded at the point it's made — question, options weighed, choice, rationale — so its outcome can be recorded later and advice quality becomes inspectable over time (ROADMAP.md, goal ledger with outcomes). This schema describes the record's `data`, not the enclosing envelope; see outcome.schema.json for the paired follow-up record.

hypothesisIds.description: Optional; ids of prior observations/hypotheses this decision was grounded in.
